issue.standard_remedy: Fix the payment run to pay 2/10 invoices inside the discount window
issue.summary: 316 discount-eligible invoices paid without the 2% discount

plan.diagnosis: 316 discount-eligible invoices in SAP ECC 6.0 were paid at an average of 42.9 days instead of within the 2/10 net terms discount window, resulting in USD 189,473 in lost early-pay discounts over the trailing 12 months. The root cause is a payment run configuration failure combined with a 53.4% late payment rate, indicating systemic AP process breakdown that misses the 10-day discount cutoff.

remedy_steps.step: Audit SAP payment program (F110) parameters and baseline configuration to identify why discount-eligible invoices are not prioritized; review payment proposal variant settings and discount eligibility logic

Reconfigure SAP F110 payment run to automatically prioritize all 2/10 discount-eligible invoices and schedule bi-weekly payment runs aligned to discount deadlines; update payment proposal parameters to flag discount opportunities
Implement automated workflow alert (SAP workflow or external tool) to notify AP team 5 days before discount windows expire for high-value invoices (threshold >USD 1,000)
Conduct root cause analysis on the 53.4% late payment rate; address invoice receipt delays, approval bottlenecks, and three-way matching exceptions that delay processing
Train AP team on revised payment run procedures and establish weekly monitoring dashboard tracking discount capture rate, days-to-pay, and at-risk discount invoices

plan.expected_impact: Capturing 80% of lost discounts would yield USD 151,578 in annual savings from the USD 189,473 currently forgone across 316 invoices.
kpis: Discount capture rate (target: 95% of eligible invoices paid within 10 days)
Average days-to-pay for discount-eligible invoices (target: <8 days)
Percentage of invoices paid late (target: reduce from 53.4% to <10%)
Monthly discount dollars captured vs. available (target: >USD 12,600/month)
risks: AP resource constraints may prevent bi-weekly payment run execution discipline
Invoice approval delays upstream of AP may persist despite payment run fixes, limiting discount capture
Supplier payment term changes or disputes may reduce discount-eligible invoice population
Cash flow restrictions could force finance to delay payments even when discount windows are identified
erp_actions: Modify SAP payment program variant (F110) to sort discount-eligible invoices to top priority in payment proposals
Set payment terms baseline check in vendor master (LFB1) to flag 2/10 terms and enable automatic discount calculation verification
Configure SAP discount monitoring report (S_ALR_87012357 or custom Z-report) to run weekly and distribute to AP leadership
Enable payment block (H flag in BSEG) override workflow for discount-eligible invoices to expedite approval
Schedule automatic payment runs twice monthly (day 5 and day 20) in F110 to align with typical 10-day discount windows
